objective: Create an original, publicly reviewable development-only reference calculus defining action-caused graph changes and signed factual language independently of model training, then falsify its edge cases with a separately implemented checker. Neither component may mint a prospective L10 family, authenticate an independent owner, or become an FSA scoring authority.

strict_domain.public_state: complete finite signed graph; no hidden state
strict_domain.state_change: selected subject+relation has exactly one true object after intervention; all other same-subject candidates explicitly false; other subjects/relations unchanged
strict_domain.source_safety: reject self loops, out-of-namespace facts, incompatible polarity sets, malformed actor tokens and duplicate facts

predeclared_development_tests: action changes exactly the targeted subject/relation and conserves every other graph fact
alternative interventions produce different causal consequences only when actual target object differs
same-source replay must be deterministic, with no hidden seed or oracle feedback
explicit negation and subject/object inversion cannot pass valid complete semantic equality
rendered terminal graph includes every true and false signed proposition, with no omission/extra fact; all graph failures counted
intentionally corrupted counterfactual transitions fail independent checker
validating an action stream does not accept fabricated target states, repeated items or unknown relations
source-only code must not generate seeds or protected examples, nor import L9/WebNLG or FORGE execution authority
frozen_stop: If open development source calculus is inconsistent or independent checker cannot detect adversarial wrong transitions, no independent source birth proposal. Even if all dev checks pass, source FIRST USE remains NO-GO pending genuinely independent source-owner generator and separately authenticated scorer.

limits.source_protection: no prospective examples, no labels, no test data, no source owner seed, no protected run
